name: com.crowdwisdomtrading.api/crowd-wisdom-trading
title: CrowdWisdom Trading
description: Crowd sentiment score (-100 to +100) from thousands of pro traders: stocks, ETFs, crypto, FX.

tools.name: get_crowd_sentiment_today
tools.description: Today's crowd sentiment for one US stock or ETF from CrowdWisdom Trading: one score from -100 (all bearish) to +100 (all bullish), combining what traders say on YouTube, X, StockTwits, Reddit, brokers, podcasts and newsletters, plus how many traders it is based on. Use when the user asks about sentiment, the crowd's or retail traders' mood, or whether traders are bullish or bearish on a ticker today.

ticker.description: US stock or ETF ticker symbol, e.g. NVDA, TSLA, SPY. Use the symbol, not the company name.

tools.name: get_crowd_sentiment_week
tools.description: This week's crowd sentiment for one US stock or ETF from CrowdWisdom Trading: one score from -100 (all bearish) to +100 (all bullish), combining what traders say on YouTube, X, StockTwits, Reddit, brokers, podcasts and newsletters since Monday, plus how many traders it is based on. Use when the user asks about weekly sentiment or the crowd's view for the week on a ticker.

ticker.description: US stock or ETF ticker symbol, e.g. NVDA, TSLA, SPY. Use the symbol, not the company name.
